column1: # op → native word. Columns (tab-separated): op  dtype  word  template  numeric
# `template` names how a generator maps the word onto the op:
#   unary_view   fn(ArrayView<T, D>, ArrayViewMut<T, D>) elementwise, same shape
#   mask_not     a "not X" mask word whose complement is the op (bool out)
#   blend        fn(mask_words, a, b|scalar, dst): Where on a packed condition
#   softmax_rows ArrayView2 softmax over axis 1, after reshaping to [rows, last]
#   gather_rows  row gather by i64 indices (ONNX negative indices)
#   view         an ndarray view/reshape method on ArrayBase, no new algebra
#   fold_checked a checked scalar op folded over the reduced axis
#   dtype_row    the op's existing DO, given one more dtype arm
# `numeric` is exact or bounded. Every `word` is checked against the ndarray
# source the probe builds with before a report cites it.
